summary: This 6-K filing reports a 1-for-5 share consolidation by J-Star Holding Co., Ltd., approved by the board on May 8, 2026, and by shareholders on June 8, 2026. Effective July 10, 2026, every five Class A and Class B ordinary shares (par value $0.50 each) convert into one share (par value $2.50 each), with fractional shares rounded up. The consolidation is designed to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule (5550(a)(2)) and maintain listing. It affects all shareholders uniformly and does not alter percentage ownership. No financial terms, advisor, or premium are involved. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
